response.overview: Ten years after being named Italy’s “Village of Villages” in 2015, Montalbano Elicona faces depopulation, abandoned homes and fading tourist appeal. Through images and testimonies collected in summer 2025, the documentary explores the decline of a once-thriving village, while giving voice to those who continue to believe in its rebirth and future.
response.title: Il Silenzio di Montalbano
